# Progress Update (2026-08-14 v4)

## Major Fix: VGIC Emulation Enabled

### Root Cause
Commit 89fb768a7 added identity Stage-2 mappings for HostReplacement device MMIO ranges
(GIC, UART). This bypassed the VGIC and PL011 emulation entirely, giving guests direct
access to physical hardware. Result: no guest console output, no interrupt virtualization.

### Fix (commit db4a3b9c4)
Removed the HostReplacement identity mapping from address_space.rs. Now all GIC and UART
accesses trap to EL2, where the VGIC and PL011 emulation handle them properly.

### Verification
- Linux VM[1] now boots with full console output through the guest console mux
- Linux kernel detects GICv3, finds redistributors, boots to userspace
- [VM 1] prefixed lines appear in the log (Booting Linux, GICv3 messages, etc.)
- RT-Thread VM[3] still has issues (stuck in early boot, no console output)

### RT-Thread Issue Analysis
RT-Thread is stuck in early boot before producing any UART output. No MMIO traps or
hypercalls are observed from VM[3]. The likely cause is:
- RT-Thread's early page table setup maps GIC physical addresses (0x08000000)
- Stage-2 fault on these addresses should trigger MMIO handler
- But RT-Thread may be stuck in a loop before reaching GIC/UART init
- Legacy GIC CPU interface address (0x08010000) is not a valid VGIC address
